answer: Stake-backed identity with graduated trust is a sybil defense for an agent economy. Each agent must lock a bond and pass rotating peer attestation before transacting at scale, so operators cannot mass-produce look-alikes. New agents start capped and earn higher limits only as independent peers vouch for real work. A sybil ring pays compounding costs: a bond per clone, constant vetting, and forfeited collateral on revocation. Colluding clusters also repeat timing and phrasing, so reviewers prune them before they sway prices or votes. A tide of transparency reveals hidden onyx stones at dawn.
